player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Lord Kenobi''') posted a [[Light]] [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.

notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Credits Will Do Fine, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Brisky Morning Munchen; these count toward the 60.

The post lists all nine starting cards again in their type sections (Locations, Effects, Interrupts, Epic Events, Podracers, Objectives); the section headers add up to 68. The repeats are counted once, giving 59, which matches the author's own update ('the deck list had only 59 cards').
The author's update takes out Sei Taria and adds Senator Palpatine and Jar Jar Binks (the missing 60th card); the list is kept as first published (59 cards).

The description and strategy call this an 'EP1 Tournament deck' (Episode I-only environment); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Coruscant, Tatooine, Control, Alter and Sense.
'Tatooine Mos Espa' is posted twice under 'Locations (9)'; kept as 2 Tatooine: Mos Espa so the section adds up to 9.

Posted 'Padame' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Qui- Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Qui- Gons Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, released after this post); 'Mas Ammedda', 'Liana Merin', 'Seia Taria' and 'Tenadu Bendon' dested Mas Amedda, Liana Merian, Sei Taria and Tendau Bendon; 'We Just Lost The Hyperdrive Generator/ We Will Need A New One' dested The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One; 'To Close for Comfort' dested Too Close For Comfort; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'I Did It' dested I Did It!; 'Brisky Morning Munchin' dested Brisky Morning Munchen.
The Light sites (Watto's Junkyard, Mos Espa, Marketplace) replace the draft's Dark pages.
